hook.text: What if mosquitoes just... didn't exist?

deadly.text: Mosquitoes are the deadliest animal on Earth. Malaria alone kills around 600,000 people every year. And that's before dengue, Zika, West Nile and yellow fever.

saved.text: Delete them overnight, and hundreds of thousands of lives are saved. Every single year.

pond.text: But there's a catch. Mosquito larvae are food. Fish, frogs and dragonflies eat them in ponds all over the world. Some of them would go hungry.

arctic.text: In the Arctic, mosquito swarms get so huge they feed millions of migrating birds every summer. That buffet would vanish.

flower.text: And male mosquitoes don't bite. They drink nectar, and some Arctic orchids rely on them to pollinate.

verdict.text: So, would nature collapse? Probably not. Of about 3,500 species, only a small fraction bite humans. Most scientists think nature would adapt, and other insects would fill the gap. So... would you delete them? Comment below.
